portal.title: CodeEditorLand Portal Roadmap
portal.subtitle: Land supports four authentication tiers: Cloud account sync, OAuth provider identity, local-first Air daemon control, and enterprise SSO. The local editor works without any of them.

cloud.title: Cloud Plan
cloud.subtitle:
Planned hosted sync for users who want account-backed state.

The local editor should remain useful without this service.

feature.backup: Planned encrypted backup for selected configuration
feature.extension: Marketplace installation is planned after local extension paths stabilize

capability.jwt: Planned account tokens for hosted services
capability.okta: Okta SSO belongs to the enterprise plan
capability.mfa: MFA support depends on the configured identity provider

provider.title: Provider Plan
provider.subtitle: Sign in with GitHub, GitLab, or Google through OAuth 2.0 PKCE. Provider identity links your editor session to source repositories and hosted services you already use.
provider.oauthNote: OAuth 2.0   Profile + Email scope   Linked to your preferences

feature.github: GitHub identity is planned as a low-friction sign-in option
feature.sso: Single sign-on across Land services is planned
feature.repo: Settings sync tied to provider identity is planned
feature.team: Organization and team membership sync is planned
feature.ci: CI/CD integration belongs to later portal work

capability.oauth: OAuth 2.0 / PKCE support where provider flows are enabled
capability.scope: Minimal OAuth scopes - only what each provider integration requires
capability.token: Refresh token handling depends on provider configuration

localfirst.title: Local-First
localfirst.subtitle:
The Air daemon runs as a persistent background process handling updates, file indexing, signing, and health monitoring.

The portal surface for browser-to-daemon control is in development - the daemon itself is active source today.
localfirst.note: Zero cloud dependency   JWT certificates   mTLS

feature.build: Launching builds from the website console is planned
feature.deploy: Deploying changes into a running editor is planned
feature.parity: Installed VS Code extensions run unmodified through the Cocoon path when their APIs are implemented
feature.offline: Local editor operation should not require a cloud login
feature.bake: Embedding portal surfaces into the editor is planned

capability.mtls: mTLS mutual authentication is planned for daemon control
capability.crdt: CRDT state synchronization - planned for conflict-free offline edits
capability.team: Fully local team management is planned
capability.cert: Local certificate authority code exists in Mountain; portal integration is planned

enterprise.title: Enterprise Plan
enterprise.subtitle: Connect Land to your organisation's identity infrastructure via OIDC, SAML 2.0, or SCIM. Enterprise SSO and directory provisioning are in development.
enterprise.note: OpenID Connect Discovery  + SAML 2.0 Assertion  + SCIM 2.0 User Provisioning

feature.azure: Azure AD / Entra ID integration is planned
feature.group: IdP group to Land role mapping is planned

capability.mfa: MFA enforcement depends on the configured IdP
capability.ca: Organization CA certificate management is planned
